note: An INDEX of standing rulings so briefs, critiques, queries and reviews can cite a stable id (RUL-nnn) instead of restating a sentence. It is not an authority: every entry names its source, and where the source and this index disagree the source wins (see DOCS.md precedence: the Bible, then its newest dated ruling). Astra's decision log (ASTRA-Dnnn, design/astra/DECISION_LOG.md on its canonical branch) stays Astra's record; entries here cite it. Add a ruling by appending; retire one by adding a later entry that lists it under supersedes, never by editing or deleting it. Checked by tools/check_rulings.py.

rulings.summary: Astra holds executive production authority for the v2 rebuild under the owner's mandate; its authority hierarchy (AUTH-04) orders the work: accepted M11 boundary, real F01 owner-first cut, exterior route, F03 vertical proof, structural breadth.
main is the single integration line. The Astra canonical line reconciles onto main; nothing is integrated into two lines at once. Owner may override.

Capture success cannot promote a runtime contract. The ledger grants RUNTIME_PROVEN only to a schema-2 runtime_contract receipt with completed execution, exit 0, current test-source and runtime-input hashes and executed contracts. Wrapper run receipts (suite_run) are not runtime contracts.
The committed building selector stays v1 until an authorized cutover; cutover and rollback change only DEFAULT_ID.
The campaign opens on Saturday, November 10, 1928.

Props are regenerated in Blender at higher fidelity, taking the 2026-09-18 prop reference critiques as the specification. This supersedes only the PROP_ART_BRIEF section 3 line that props are GDScript primitives with no mesh import path. Prop scripts remain the owners of state, interaction, save and acoustic authority; only the visual build moves to a generated glTF with named parts. Generated glTF is never hand-edited.
rulings.source: owner instruction in chat 2026-09-18; design/PROP_ART_BRIEF.md section 3; branch:claude/prop-reference-brief:design/PROP_MODELING_TEXTURING_BRIEF_2026-09-18.md

rulings.summary: Third-party reference photographs inform form, proportion, part layout and finish only. They are never projected, baked, traced or used as texture sources, and their bytes are never committed or shipped; provenance is kept and they are cited by URL.

Generated textures carry no letters, numbers, words or logos; signage lettering is Label3D. New material keys go through MATERIAL_CATALOG in gen_layout.py and ingest_material_sources.py (SLOTS and GODOT_STAGE) or they stay flat colour.

Godot runs go through tools/run_godot_serial.ps1, tools/run_godot_long_suite.ps1 or tools/lane.ps1. The shared mutex and the Godot process census are never bypassed, and nobody closes another agent's or the owner's Godot process to free the lane.
The working tree is shared by several agents. Stage named paths only, never git add -A or git add .; never use a bare git stash; restore Godot's line-ending-only .import churn before committing.

A design document states its class in an 'Evidence class:' header in its first 30 lines. The ledger admits by filename marker and refuses a marker-named document whose header says INERT; inert documents write space ids in bold, not backticks.
